neighbours.label: a noun naming an added cost or burden (tax, fee, overhead, barrier)
fire: I am writing in support of the new soda tax proposed by the council.
Visitors should note that there is a small parking fee at the gate.
The upload overhead is about seven milliseconds per file.
For many families, cost remains the biggest barrier to treatment.
The airline added a baggage surcharge to every ticket.
Each transaction carries a processing fee of two percent.
The city introduced a tourist tax on hotel stays.
Language is a serious barrier for new immigrants.
quiet: I am writing in support of the new soda brand launched by the company.
Visitors should note that there is a small parking lot at the gate.
The upload speed is about seven megabytes per second.
For many families, cost remains the biggest reason to delay treatment.
The airline added a baggage tracker to every ticket.
Each transaction carries a reference number of ten digits.
The city introduced a tourist map for hotel guests.
Language is a serious interest for new immigrants.

notes: Top examples are mixed (fast, between, prefix); this is the strongest shared pattern.
